create_adversarial_env: create an AdversarialEnv instance with custom n_clutter, grid size, and max_steps parameters
step_adversary_place_objects: call step_adversary with a location integer to place the goal, agent, or walls in sequence
reset_agent_restart_episode: call reset_agent to restart the agent at its start position while preserving the adversary-designed level layout
mutate_level_edit_grid: call mutate_level with num_edits to randomly modify walls, agent, and goal positions in the current grid
reset_to_level_from_string: call reset_to_level with a space-separated string of adversary action integers to reconstruct a saved level
